name: pdk-ncbitax2lin-dataframe
instr:
We join read classifications to the lineage table ncbitax2lin writes, and more reads now carry tax ids NCBI has since merged into other taxa. Those ids have no row, so the reads lose their lineage. Our current dump, merged.dmp included, is in /data/taxdump/.

Please add a `--merged-file` option, so that `ncbitax2lin --nodes-file nodes.dmp --names-file names.dmp --merged-file merged.dmp --output lineages.csv.gz` also writes one row per retired tax id. Its tax_id is the retired id, and every lineage column has the value from the row of the taxon in nodes.dmp that the id belongs to today. A retired id that doesn't lead to such a taxon gets no row. With the option the table also has a `merged_into` column right after tax_id: on a retired id's row, the tax_id of that taxon; empty on the rows of the taxa in nodes.dmp, which otherwise stay exactly as they are without the option.

The rest of the layout stays as today: the same lineage columns in the same order, tax ids written as whole numbers, and rows sorted by tax_id ascending over current and retired ids together. Without the option the output is exactly what it is today, and an empty merged.dmp adds no rows. If a merged.dmp line isn't two tax ids, the run should fail before writing anything, leaving an existing output file as it was.

The existing tests in /app/tests and the repo's CI lint (black, isort, mypy and pylint, with its settings) have to keep passing. There's no network here.
